name: skill_capacity_v1
purpose: After P0 input/mask checks, measure whether fixed base policy produces admissible multi-action skills under unchanged directional-variant gates. No optimizer, no performance claim.
collection_library: empty and unchanged for all 128 episodes; all admissions performed afterwards, in seed order
no_selection: No seed replacement, early success stop, extra sampling, threshold changes, model update or checkpoint. Diagnostic library cannot be used as training cold start.
analysis: exact layout and initial-position duplicate counts
mask span integrity and reward decomposition
decision: If admissible multi-action skills exist, design a separately bounded cross-batch experiment with checkpoint space resolved. If not, identify the dominant quality/distillation bottleneck before any further PPO; do not expand this sampling run.
